A Healthy Choice of Horse Treat
For Your Best Friend

A to Z Horse Cookies are a softer, healthier horse treat that is LOW CARB, LOW SUGAR, WHEAT, CORN, SOY, AND ALFALFA FREE. Our cookies are an excellent treat for the mature horse, and the youngster.

We have solved a problem that has plagued horse owners for years, creating a cookie that helps you get medication down your horse with ease, rather than the traditional bran mash method. Our lite molasses cookie is the perfect cookie that will help you with your needs. Just break your cookie in half, place the pill, or pills on the ﬂat side, and give it a squeeze and press. You will see how easy this can be.

The Cinnamon Agave cookie (Blonde Bits of Health) is a great favorite for all too! Many use this brand for pill-popping.

We are one of the first horse cookie companies that have run labs on Carbs, Sugars, and calories … Please review our (LAB ANALYSIS)

A to Z Horse Cookies are made in the USA. Our horse treats are made with the finest ingredients. Try our cookies and see what all the hoopla is about!
